name: resource-internet
description: Sequential resource transfers (20-120 KB) through a shaped pipe at an internet wire: 50 Mbps with 25 ms one-way latency - the TCP hop to a remote community instance. Bandwidth is cheap, round trips are not: every handshake the protocol spends costs 50 ms.
conformance: settled == received with byte-identical totals and zero failures; the pipe delays, it never drops
